allow: Bash(powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Id 7832 -Force; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; if \(Get-Process -Id 7832 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { 'still running' } else { 'stopped' }")

PowerShell($conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conn\) { $conn.OwningProcess | Select-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { "Stopping $\($p.ProcessName\) \($\($p.Id\)\)"; Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force } } } else { "nothing on 5000" }; Start-Sleep 2; if \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { "5000 still in use" } else { "5000 free" })

PowerShell($conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4200 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conn\) { $conn.OwningProcess | Select-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { "Stopping $\($p.ProcessName\) \($\($p.Id\)\)"; Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force } } } else { "nothing on 4200" }; Start-Sleep 2; if \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4200 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { "4200 still in use" } else { "4200 free" })
